frames.name: Bulwark Frame
frames.text: A heavy front-line chassis. Tough but slow.

frames.name: Strider Frame
frames.text: A light, quick body for close fighting. Fragile.

frames.name: Conduit Frame
frames.text: A channel for spirit power. Strong magic, thin plating.

frames.name: Colossus Frame
frames.text: A towering hull of stacked plates. Huge and nearly unbreakable, but it lumbers. Cannot be Stunned.

arms.name: Hammer Arms
arms.text: Slow, heavy STR blows at the front-row enemy nearest its lane; it cannot reach the back row while anyone stands in front. Every second hit Stuns.

arms.name: Shield Arms
arms.text: Quick STR jabs at the nearest front-row enemy. From the front row, takes a hit aimed at a back-row ally in its own or a neighbouring lane (once between turns).

arms.name: Spirit Cannon
arms.text: Magical MAG shots that fire just as well from the back row, straight down the lane at the nearest front-row enemy.

arms.name: Bow Arms
arms.text: STR arrows lobbed over the front line at the back-row enemy nearest its lane. Fires just as well from the back row.

arms.name: Aegis Arms
arms.text: A tower shield and a short jab at the nearest front-row enemy. Each turn it raises Ward of 2 + half its DEF on itself and the ally sharing its lane.

arms.name: Pike Arms
arms.text: A long STR thrust at the nearest front-row enemy that punches through half its armour.

arms.name: Lantern Arms
arms.text: A spirit lamp. Weak MAG flashes at the nearest front-row enemy from either row; every hit mends the most wounded ally for 2 + a third of MAG.

arms.name: Chain Flail
arms.text: A heavy STR swing at the nearest front-row enemy; half the blow carries on to the golems beside it in that row.

arms.name: Twin Blades
arms.text: Two quick STR cuts every turn at the nearest front-row enemy. Each cut is a separate hit, so sigils fire twice.

arms.name: Storm Staff
arms.text: Magical MAG bolts called down on the back-row enemy nearest its lane. Fires just as well from the back row.

arms.name: Reaper Scythe
arms.text: A sweeping STR cut at the nearest front-row enemy. Against an enemy below half HP it strikes 60% harder.

legs.name: Pillar Legs
legs.text: Planted and steady: cannot be Stunned.

legs.name: Spider Legs
legs.text: Skitters past the front line: melee attacks strike the weakest enemy anywhere, at full power even from the back row.

legs.name: Tower Legs
legs.text: Squat, braced stone columns. In the front row it takes 25% less damage from attacks.

legs.name: Stilt Legs
legs.text: Tall, thin fen stilts. From the back row its attacks strike 25% harder.

legs.name: Crawler Treads
legs.text: Grinding iron treads. Cannot be Stunned or set Burning.

legs.name: Ice Skates
legs.text: Bladed feet that glide over anything. Quick, and it leaps forward at the start of battle (+50 gauge).

sigils.name: Ember Sigil
sigils.text: Attacks set the target Burning (+1 stack).

sigils.name: Guard Bell
sigils.text: At the start of battle: Taunts enemies for 2 turns and gains 6 Ward.

sigils.name: Surge Lens
sigils.text: Hits on a Burning or Soaked enemy arc half their damage to another enemy.

sigils.name: Moss Charm
sigils.text: The first time HP falls below half, gain Regen: heal 3 at the start of each of the next 3 turns.

sigils.name: Stoneskin Rune
sigils.text: When struck, the body hardens: gain Ward of 2 + half DEF (then rests for 2 turns).

sigils.name: Mending Rune
sigils.text: At the start of each turn, heals the most wounded ally (or itself) for 2 + half MAG.

sigils.name: Leech Fang
sigils.text: Every hit drinks: heals itself for 35% of the damage dealt.

sigils.name: Thorn Crest
sigils.text: When struck, thorns lash the attacker for 2 + a quarter of DEF.

sigils.name: War Drum
sigils.text: At the start of battle the whole team surges forward (+30 gauge).

sigils.name: Hunter's Brand
sigils.text: Attacks mark the target Exposed for 2 turns: it takes 30% more damage from attacks.

sigils.name: Frost Sigil
sigils.text: Attacks chill the target, slowing it (-25 gauge).

sigils.name: Vengeance Idol
sigils.text: Whenever an ally falls, it surges forward (+60 gauge) and gains 6 Ward.

sigils.name: Cleansing Charm
sigils.text: At the start of each turn, washes Burn, Soaked, Weaken, Expose and Stun off itself and the ally sharing its lane.

sigils.name: Hex Eye
sigils.text: Attacks Weaken the target for 2 turns: its attacks deal 30% less damage.

sigils.name: Storm Coil
sigils.text: At the start of each turn, a crackle strikes every enemy for 1 + a fifth of MAG.

sigils.name: Phoenix Ember
sigils.text: Once per battle, a blow that would destroy it instead leaves it standing at 40% HP.

materials.name: Stone
materials.text: Old ruin stone. Sturdy and plain.

earth.name: Living Rock
earth.text: The stone answers its own kind and knits around the spirit: HP +6, DEF +1.

materials.name: Wood
materials.text: Light, springy timber. Quicker and roomier than stone, but it splinters.

fire.name: Kindling
fire.text: The body burns as it fights: STR +3, MAG +3, DEF -3, RES -1. Anyone who strikes it is singed (+1 Burn).

nature.name: Heartwood
nature.text: The timber takes root again: HP +6, RES +1 and Regen for its first 3 turns.

materials.name: Ice
materials.text: Hard, cold and slow to move. Shrugs off blows and spells alike.

water.name: Glacier
water.text: The spirit keeps the ice whole: DEF +2, RES +2, and whoever strikes it is Soaked for 2 turns.

fire.name: Steam
fire.text: The ice melts around the flame: DEF -3, SPD +4, MAG +2, and a scalding mist Soaks every enemy at the start of battle.

materials.name: Bronze
materials.text: Heavy cast metal from the old bells. Hits hard and holds, but conducts spells.

lightning.name: Live Wire
lightning.text: Current runs through the metal: MAG +3, SPD +2, RES -2, and every hit arcs 40% of its damage to another enemy.

materials.name: Crystal
materials.text: Strange humming crystal grown in the vault. Focuses spirit power, but it is brittle.

wind.name: Wind Chime
wind.text: The wind sings through the facets: SPD +2, and the whole team surges forward at the start of battle (+40 gauge).

materials.name: Bogwood
materials.text: Black, waterlogged fen timber. Heavy and roomy, it soaks up spells but moves slowly.

nature.name: Mangrove
nature.text: Roots knot through the wet wood: HP +4, and when struck it gains 3 Ward (then rests a turn).

water.name: Bog Spring
water.text: The spirit wells up through the timber: RES +1, and it heals 2 at the start of every turn.

materials.name: Obsidian
materials.text: Glassy volcanic rock from the kilns. Razor edges hit hard, but it chips.

fire.name: Magma Heart
fire.text: The glass runs molten: STR +2, MAG +2, and every hit sets the target Burning.

earth.name: Basalt
earth.text: The earth spirit cools the glass into columns: HP +10, DEF +2.

materials.name: Fulgurite
materials.text: Sand fused by lightning on the Storm Crown. Crackles with power, but holds little back.

lightning.name: Thunderglass
lightning.text: The bolt that made it answers: MAG +2, and hits on a Soaked enemy arc their full damage to another enemy.

wind.name: Singing Glass
wind.text: Wind howls through the fused tubes: SPD +2, and every hit slows the target (-20 gauge).
